system.description:
You gain this state while you are at 0 hit points, and you lose it if you are defeated or if your hit point total increases above 0. Damage-dealing states are paused while you have this state, and you also ignore minor environmental hazards, such as terrain damage.

When you are dealt damage, you must make a tenacity check of MIGHT + SPIRIT vs. 10 + DAMAGE. The first time you fail a tenacity check each encounter, lose 2 endurance.

  • On a success, you withstand the attack.

  • On a failure, you are defeated and suffer a scar.

  • On a failure with a shadow, you are defeated and suffer an injury.

  • On a failure with two shadows, you die.
